item.title: Can /var/lib/docker Be Mounted on Remote Storage?
item.description: No. 1. Background When building a reliable, stable operations system on top of Kubernetes, destroying and creating virtual machines (VMs) is the norm. VMs provide compute and memory resources, while external storage is exposed to PVCs in the cluster through a StorageClass. Against this backdrop, how to initialize a VM quickly becomes a new challenge.
